rows.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rows.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

rows.name: DEPRECATED: State Synchronization Error
rows.description: This entry was deprecated because it overlapped the same concepts as race condition (CWE-362) and Improper Synchronization (CWE-662).

rows.name: Permission Race Condition During Resource Copy
rows.description: The product, while copying or cloning a resource, does not set the resource's permissions or access control until the copy is complete, leaving the resource exposed to other spheres while the copy is taking place.

rows.name: Incomplete Denylist to Cross-Site Scripting
rows.description: The product uses a denylist-based protection mechanism to defend against XSS attacks, but the denylist is incomplete, allowing XSS variants to succeed.

rows.name: Improper Adherence to Coding Standards
rows.description: The product does not follow certain coding rules for development, which can lead to resultant weaknesses or increase the severity of the associated vulnerabilities.

rows.name: DEPRECATED: Uncontrolled File Descriptor Consumption
rows.description: This entry has been deprecated because it was a duplicate of CWE-774. All content has been transferred to CWE-774.

rows.name: Excessively Complex Data Representation
rows.description: The product uses an unnecessarily complex internal representation for its data structures or interrelationships between those structures.

rows.name: ASP.NET Misconfiguration: Improper Model Validation
rows.description: The ASP.NET application does not use, or incorrectly uses, the model validation framework.

rows.name: DEPRECATED: Use of Uninitialized Resource
rows.description: This entry has been deprecated because it was a duplicate of CWE-908. All content has been transferred to CWE-908.
